purpose: Replace cross-sensor absolute M3 thresholds with a label-free sequential batch-budget scheduler and validate unchanged M4/M6 models on Photoneo tracks disjoint from calibration.

claim_boundary.allowed: Zero-label Photoneo score calibration with evaluation on calibration-track-disjoint Photoneo observations.
forbidden: reuse of the consumed R1 Photoneo split as sealed evidence

realsense_development.source: R1 M3 nested physical-instance-grouped OOF rows
realsense_development.allowed_use: Validate the scheduler using already cross-fitted predictions and development outcomes.
realsense_development.forbidden_use: Refit or select a new marginal-value model.

allowed_uses: cross-view GT transform consistency audit only
forbidden_uses: pose utility or success label tuning
M3 model fitting or quota selection
M4 feature, ranker, or threshold selection

target_selection: Exclude every R1 calibration track before choosing targets or candidate views.
Within each object, order untouched tracks by SHA-256 of 'r2-track|' plus track ID.
Within each track, order input-valid observations by SHA-256 of 'r2-sample|' plus sample ID.
Round-robin one observation per ordered track before reusing a track until ten targets are selected.
For each target, select four same-track candidate views using the frozen camera-center diversity rule.
selection_may_read: oracle track association for split isolation only
photoneo_sealed.reopen_policy: Any failure after label open is final for this split. Any method or audit change requires a new protocol version and different untouched tracks.

scheduler.batch_definition: All target poses in the frozen evaluation invocation.
scheduler.stage_1: After target-only inference, rank positive k1 predicted marginal values and acquire views two and three for at most q1 targets.
scheduler.stage_2: After the selected targets have three acquired views, rank their positive k3 predicted marginal values and acquire views four and five for at most q2 targets.

q1.source: Frozen R1 primary OOF count with budget greater than one

q2.source: Frozen R1 primary OOF count with budget five

scheduler.tie_break: descending predicted marginal value, then ascending SHA-256 of group ID
scheduler.nesting: q2 selections must be a subset of q1 selections

M4-R2.action: reuse the unchanged R1 CAD visibility ranker on the M3-R2 continue population

M6-R2.action: Rerun nested grouped CV with only final selected-output features, then refit that restricted family on the full development set.

evaluator_transform_audit.derivation: Preserve the inherited 0.01-pixel audit tolerance in width-normalized image coordinates instead of applying a 1280-pixel threshold to 2064-pixel images.

execution_order: validate M3-R2 scheduler on frozen RealSense nested OOF rows
dry-run M3-R2 scheduler on R1 Photoneo label-free scores
freeze code, protocol, scheduler receipt, and new track-disjoint sealed package
run FoundationPose inference with the already validated resource chunks
freeze M3-R2, M4-R2, final pose, and M6-R2 decisions without evaluator access
open the new evaluator exactly once
